lines.Dodgers fans: Disappointed that Ohtani struck out swinging on a filthy pitch from Yesavage.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Thrilled that Yesavage struck out Ohtani swinging to start the World Series.
lines.Neutral fans: Amazed that young Yesavage struck out Ohtani on a nasty splitter pitch.

moments.play: Alejandro Kirk walks. Bo Bichette to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell lacks command early, allowing walks with bases loaded in the first inning.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Alejandro Kirk works an excellent at-bat, drawing a walk to load the bases.
lines.Neutral fans: Alejandro Kirk demonstrates great plate discipline, working a quality at-bat against Snell.

moments.play: Tommy Edman singles on a ground ball to third baseman Ernie Clement. Max Muncy to 3rd. Enrique Hernández to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Tommy Edman delivers with a clutch single, advancing runners and keeping the rally alive.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Bad luck strikes again as Edman's bunt single loads the bases against Yesavage.
lines.Neutral fans: Tommy Edman tops a pitch for an infield hit, extending the Dodgers threat with bases loaded.

moments.play: Shohei Ohtani grounds out to first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr.

lines.Dodgers fans: Andy Pages swung at a bad pitch when Ohtani grounded out, wasting a scoring opportunity.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Trey Yesavage escaped the inning with minimal damage despite Ohtani's threat.
lines.Neutral fans: Ohtani failed to capitalize on the opportunity, showing unclutch performance in this situation.

moments.play: Andrés Giménez strikes out on a foul tip.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell makes an incredible defensive play to get Ernie Clement out at third base.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Ernie Clement makes a terrible baserunning mistake trying to reach third with two outs.
lines.Neutral fans: Ernie Clement gets thrown out at third on an overly aggressive baserunning attempt.

moments.play: Teoscar Hernández grounds out, second baseman Bo Bichette to first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Will Smith to 3rd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Bo Bichette makes an incredible defensive play to get Teoscar Hernández out.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Bo Bichette delivers an amazing play at second base, potentially saving the game.
lines.Neutral fans: Bo Bichette executes an insane defensive play from up the middle for the out.

moments.play: Daulton Varsho homers (3) on a fly ball to center field. Alejandro Kirk scores.

lines.Dodgers fans: Frustrated that Blake Snell threw a center-cut fastball to Daulton Varsho.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Celebrating Daulton Varsho's home run tying the game.
lines.Neutral fans: Amazed the game is tied after Varsho's homer off Snell.

moments.play: Shohei Ohtani called out on strikes.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers fans believe the umpire made a terrible call against Shohei Ohtani.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays fans are pleased with the strikeout call on Shohei Ohtani.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans are divided on whether the umpire's strikeout call on Shohei Ohtani was correct.

moments.play: Alejandro Kirk singles on a ground ball to right fielder Teoscar Hernández. Isiah Kiner-Falefa to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell is struggling badly and needs to be pulled immediately from the game.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Alejandro Kirk is finding his swing and hitting Snell well tonight.
lines.Neutral fans: The Blue Jays are hitting Blake Snell effectively with Kirk's single as their ninth hit.

moments.play: Daulton Varsho hit by pitch. Isiah Kiner-Falefa to 3rd. Alejandro Kirk to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell lost command and bases loaded situation with Sheehan entering feels catastrophic.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Varsho's at-bat with bases loaded presents huge opportunity against struggling Blake Snell.
lines.Neutral fans: Blake Snell's control issues created bases loaded jam with no outs in World Series.

moments.play: Addison Barger hits a grand slam (3) to center field. Nathan Lukes scores. Andrés Giménez scores. George Springer scores.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers fans devastated by Addison Barger's grand slam clearing the bases.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays fans ecstatic as Addison Barger crushes a grand slam.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans amazed by Addison Barger's grand slam changing the game.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers fans frustrated with Enrique Hernández striking out during offensive struggles.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays fans thrilled with Chris Bassitt's dominant relief pitching performance.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans impressed by Blue Jays scoring and urging Bassitt back for ninth inning.
